newsitem.title: UK: IBCA cuts Hambros Bank long-, short-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA cuts Hambros Bank long-, short-term ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had cut the long- and short-term rating of Hambros Bank to A minus and A2 respectively.
But IBCA said it had left the long- and short-term ratings of Hambros Plc unchanged at A minus and A2 respectively.
"The bank remains very liquid and capital ratios strong, but Hambros' 1995/96 performance was poor, with large bad debt provisions and reorganisation costs in the bank," IBCA said in a statement.
"It may be some time before Hambros (Bank) returns to a satisfactory level of profitability. In view of this, IBCA has lowered the bank's short and long-term ratings," it said.
